name: Memory Detective: Akira
source:
New Detroit, 2142

A billion-dollar city where hardly a cent touches the ground... Instead, money is almost exclusively exchanged through the violent underbelly of society.

[i]What goes on there is an open secret—a mystery to nobody.

Can you rescue it?[/i]

You are Agent Akira of the Psychosecurity Agency, assigned to the New Detroit Police Department in order to help them dissolve crime using your special skill: Memory Tracing.

Find yourself in a dazzling cyberpunk city and scour its most extravagant highs and lowest troughs in your adventure to save the city from the shadowy organizations that control it!

At first on your own, you slowly learn to like your colleagues – and even your enemies – to help save New Detroit.

[From [url=https://games2see.itch.io/memory-detective-akira]Itch.io[/url]]
